$comment: Shared VfDivider cases. Plain data only. The vocabulary is the historical Vue contract at fd793696f50d3be0fcd3788f0f8f751c63869963. The component has no slot, so there is no "content". The catalog's job is the accessibility quirk: aria-orientation is written on both orientations, role=separator only on the vertical one, and a consumer can override either because attrs are bound after the component's own attributes. scripts/ci/presentation-coverage.mjs is what stops the list eroding.

propVocabulary.orientation: VfDividerOrientation: horizontal | vertical. Defaults to horizontal. Unlike the toned spans in the same batch, the modifier is always emitted, including at the default.
